_note: Hand-created via the SDK as casey@ourresearch.org (scripts/monitoring_create_alert.py). Not a bundle resource: DABs alerts must be owned by the deploying identity (github-actions-deploy), which has no access to openalex.monitoring or the warehouse, and the bundle-level run_as (terraform_user) is rejected for alerts. Re-run the script to update.
query_text:
WITH night AS ( SELECT current_date() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS d ), -- flagged checks, one compact entry per check, grouped by component flagged AS ( SELECT component, check_id, dimension, status, value, CASE WHEN value = FLOOR(value) AND ABS(value) < 1e15 THEN format_number(CAST(value AS BIGINT), 0) ELSE CAST(ROUND(value, 3) AS STRING) END AS v FROM openalex.monitoring.findings WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT d FROM night) AND status IN ('critical', 'watch') ), per_check AS ( SELECT component, status, check_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX_BY(dimension, value) AS top_dim, MAX_BY(v, value) AS top_v FROM flagged GROUP BY component, status, check_id ), per_component AS ( SELECT component, status, concat_ws(' · ', sort_array(collect_list( CASE WHEN n = 1 AND top_dim IS NULL THEN concat(check_id, ' ', top_v) WHEN n = 1 THEN concat(check_id, '[', top_dim, '] ', top_v) ELSE concat(check_id, ' ×', n, ' (top ', top_dim, ' ', top_v, ')') END))) AS txt FROM per_check GROUP BY component, status ), lists AS ( SELECT status, concat_ws('
', sort_array(collect_list(concat(component, ': ', txt)))) AS txt FROM per_component GROUP BY status ), -- author-matching health line: the numbers that describe the night whether or not anything fired m AS ( SELECT metric, dimension, value FROM openalex.monitoring.metrics WHERE component = 'author_matching' AND snapshot_date = (SELECT d FROM night) ), j AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN split(dimension, '\\|')[0] LIKE 'orcid%' THEN 'orcid' ELSE 'name' END AS fam, split(dimension, '\\|')[1] AS verdict, SUM(value) AS n FROM openalex.monitoring.metrics WHERE component = 'author_matching' AND metric = 'judge_arm_a' AND snapshot_date BETWEEN (SELECT d FROM night) - INTERVAL 6 DAYS AND (SELECT d FROM night) GROUP BY 1, 2 ), h AS ( SELECT (SELECT SUM(value) FROM m WHERE metric = 'match_outcome') AS seats, (SELECT value FROM m WHERE metric = 'match_outcome' AND dimension = 'MATCHED') AS matched, (SELECT value FROM m WHERE metric = 'match_outcome' AND dimension = 'AMBIGUOUS') AS ambiguous, (SELECT value FROM m WHERE metric = 'new_authors_minted' AND dimension IS NULL) AS minted, (SELECT value FROM m WHERE metric = 'new_works_seats' AND dimension = 'bound') AS nw_bound, (SELECT value FROM m WHERE metric = 'new_works_seats' AND dimension = 'total') AS nw_total, (SELECT value FROM m WHERE metric = 'stage_wall_sec' AND dimension = 'Author_Matching') AS wall_sec, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'same_person' THEN n END) / SUM(CASE WHEN verdict IN ('same_person', 'different_person') THEN n END) FROM j WHERE fam = 'orcid') AS prec_orcid, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN verdict = 'same_person' THEN n END) / SUM(CASE WHEN verdict IN ('same_person', 'different_person') THEN n END) FROM j WHERE fam = 'name') AS prec_name ), health AS ( SELECT concat_ws(' · ', CASE WHEN seats IS NOT NULL THEN concat('batch ', format_number(CAST(seats AS BIGINT), 0), ' seats') ELSE 'batch: no run metrics' END, CASE WHEN seats > 0 THEN concat('matched ', ROUND(100 * matched / seats), '%') END, CASE WHEN seats > 0 THEN concat('ambiguous ', ROUND(100 * ambiguous / seats), '%') END, CASE WHEN minted IS NOT NULL THEN concat('minted ', format_number(CAST(minted AS BIGINT), 0), CASE WHEN seats > 0 THEN concat(' (', ROUND(100 * minted / seats), '% of seats)') ELSE '' END) END, CASE WHEN nw_total > 0 THEN concat('new works bound ', ROUND(100 * nw_bound / nw_total, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN prec_orcid IS NOT NULL OR prec_name IS NOT NULL THEN concat('precision 7d: ORCID ', COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(100 * prec_orcid) AS STRING), '?'), '%, name tiers ', COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(100 * prec_name) AS STRING), '?'), '%') END, CASE WHEN wall_sec IS NOT NULL THEN concat('MatchAuthors ', ROUND(wall_sec / 60), ' min') END ) AS txt FROM h ) SELECT CAST(night.d AS STRING) AS report_date, COALESCE(r.headline, 'no report row for this night') AS headline, COALESCE(r.attention, r.anomalies, 'no report row for this night') AS attention, COALESCE(r.watch, 'no report row for this night') AS watch, COALESCE((SELECT txt FROM lists WHERE status = 'critical'), 'none') AS critical_checks, COALESCE((SELECT txt FROM lists WHERE status = 'watch'), 'none') AS watch_checks, (SELECT txt FROM health) AS health, concat(CAST(night.d AS STRING), ' — ', COALESCE(r.headline, 'no report')) AS subject FROM night LEFT JOIN openalex.monitoring.reports r ON r.report_date = night.d
